_description: Expected results for reverse proxy dataset: CSP with *.trusted-scripts.com must NOT be flagged as a wildcard CSP. Only standalone * (e.g. script-src *) is a full wildcard.

expected_findings.note: CSP is present and not using standalone wildcard — img-src * could be flagged as a separate sub-issue but must not be classified as 'policy disabled'

must_not_detect.rationale: FP regression: *.trusted-scripts.com is a SUBDOMAIN WHITELIST, not a full wildcard. The CSP wildcard regex uses negative lookahead to exclude this. Must not be flagged.
Server header is 'nginx' (no version) — must not be flagged as version disclosure.
